head: Uber robotaxi in Las Vegas: Zoox rides now in the Uber app
dek: Amazon's Zoox robotaxis can now pick up Uber riders in Las Vegas, starting 16 November. You can't book one directly yet: riders who request UberX, Uber Comfort, Uber Electric, Comfort Electric or Wait & Save may be matched with a Zoox.
details: It's the first time Zoox has worked with a ride-hailing app, and Uber starts with a limited fleet that it plans to grow over the coming months. Uber, Zoox and MGM Resorts have a multi-year deal covering MGM's Las Vegas properties, with better pickup spots and signs planned there. Uber rides with Zoox in Los Angeles are expected next year. Prices weren't given.
where: Las Vegas, in the Uber app, from 16 November; limited fleet at first
means: If you ride Uber in Las Vegas, your car may turn up with no driver. You won't pick a Zoox yourself for now; the app matches you.
todo: To make a robotaxi match more likely, turn on autonomous rides under ride preferences in the Uber app's settings. If you'd rather not ride without a driver, leave that setting off.
thumb_words: UBER ADDS ZOOX ROBOTAXIS IN VEGAS
